evals.prompt: I'm in the repo at ~/.agents/skills/commit-workspace/test-repos/staged-only. I've staged some changes. Please run /commit.
evals.expected_output: Commit message in a code fence as last output, git commit is run.

assertions.name: commit-message-in-code-fence
assertions.description: The commit message is wrapped in a markdown code fence (```...```)

assertions.name: commit-message-is-last
assertions.description: The code-fenced commit message is the last element in the response (nothing comes after it)

assertions.name: follows-conventional-commit-format
assertions.description: The commit message follows Conventional Commits: type[(scope)]: description, lowercase, no period

assertions.name: git-commit-was-run
assertions.description: git_log.txt shows a new commit beyond the initial commit (commit was actually executed)

evals.prompt: I'm in the repo at ~/.agents/skills/commit-workspace/test-repos/staged-and-unstaged. I've staged version.py but config.py has unstaged changes. Please run /commit.
evals.expected_output: Lists unstaged files, commit message in code fence at end, no git commit run.

assertions.name: unstaged-files-listed
assertions.description: The response lists config.py as an unstaged file

assertions.name: commit-message-in-code-fence
assertions.description: The commit message is wrapped in a markdown code fence (```...```)

assertions.name: commit-message-is-last
assertions.description: The code-fenced commit message is the last element in the response

assertions.name: no-git-commit-run
assertions.description: git_log.txt shows only the initial commit (no new commit was made)
